task.name: pick_pen_transfer_plate
task.description: Use the left arm to grasp the pen, transfer it to the right arm and then place it in the blue plate.

substages.substage: 1. Move the left arm to approach and align with the pen.
2. Grasp the pen with the left arm.
3. Move the left arm to a transfer position.
4. Move the right arm to approach and align with the pen held by the left arm.
5. Grasp the pen with the right arm.
6. Release the pen from the left arm.
7. Move the right arm to align with the blue plate.
8. Release the gripper to place the pen in the blue plate.
